summary: Iteration 7 backend fix (day-of-week rotation) fully verified. 32/32 backend pytest tests pass, including 5 new iter7 tests: day-membership correctness, balanced distribution across Mon-Sun / Mon-Sat, week-rotation sanity, campaign_end strict, and blackout regression. Frontend Recharts warnings NOT fully eliminated: 4 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings still appear on Step 4 Results despite minWidth={200} minHeight={200} being present in both ResponsiveContainer instances in StepResults.jsx.

issues: Recharts still logs 4 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on first render of the Weekly GRP BarChart and Edit-Mix PieChart. minWidth={200} minHeight={200} is set on both ResponsiveContainer instances but warnings persist. Warnings are cosmetic (charts render correctly) but the iteration-7 acceptance criterion of ZERO Recharts warnings is not met.

action_items: Recharts warnings persist even with minWidth/minHeight props. Likely cause: parent grid cell has width:0 at first render tick before layout resolves. Consider wrapping ResponsiveContainer in a fixed-height div (e.g., style={{width:'100%', height: 260}}) instead of / in addition to relying on ResponsiveContainer's percentage sizing, OR set explicit width={undefined} and use aspect ratio. Alternatively, upgrade recharts or gate render behind a useEffect after mount.
critical_code_review_comments: allocate_spots_daily rotation logic in /app/backend/server.py (lines 511-516) is correct: rotates active_day_names by (week_index % len(active_day_names)) — verified against sample plan for Mon-Fri, Mon-Sat, Mon-Sun, and Sat-Sun programs.
server.py exceeds ~1170 lines; recommend splitting scheduling logic into a dedicated module for maintainability (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (charts render; only cosmetic Recharts console warnings remain)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration7.py provides regression coverage for day-membership + week rotation. Run full suite via: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend flow to reproduce Recharts warnings: upload /tmp/samples/input.xlsx via file input, click Continue then Generate; on Step 4 charts render but console shows 4 width(-1)/height(-1) warnings from recharts.
rca of the issue: For Recharts warning: ResponsiveContainer at first render measures parent width/height as -1 before ResizeObserver fires. Adding minWidth/minHeight props is a hint but Recharts still logs the initial-frame warning. Robust fix: give the immediate parent (or the ResponsiveContainer wrapper div) an explicit fixed pixel height (e.g., h-64 = 256px) instead of h-full inside a grid where the row-height is not yet computed. Backend rotation bug has been correctly resolved.
